identity.title: Measure supported image-size memory, timing, and copy baseline

origin.summary: The current handoff selects 2D-034 as the next independent boundary after the resolved Line/Length/Mean contract; evidence is needed before any diagnostic-retention or size-policy change.

state.current_summary: 2D-034 is complete as a measurement-only baseline: Debug and Release each ran five warm-ups plus thirty measured runs for 1MP, 4512², and 8192² single- and two-layer Mean pipelines; phase timings, private-memory peak/after-run, managed bytes, identity, and estimated layer/cache bytes are recorded without changing production owners or policies.

objective.summary: Produce a current, reproducible baseline for supported video sizes that separates input allocation, input snapshot/conversion, Runner calculation, result/context clone, and bitmap publish costs, including elapsed P50/P95, private-memory peak and after-run values, managed GC bytes, and estimated layer/cache bytes.
constraints: Reuse the existing VisionRecipeRunner, public Mean tool, BitmapImageConverter, and reliability resource-probe owners; add no production performance policy or new metrology module.
Measure 1MP, 4512x4512, and 8192x8192 by default; treat 20000x20000 only as an opt-in preflight because allocation may be unsafe.
Run five warm-ups and thirty measured runs per size and pipeline shape, keep single-layer and two-layer cases distinct, and preserve deterministic success/result checks.
Write generated inputs, CSV, summaries, and reports only under D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev.
Do not touch Original, release, deploy, hardware, external services, or production owner boundaries during the measurement slice.

criteria.text: The focused Debug and Release measurement runs execute five warm-ups and thirty measured runs for each default size and single/two-layer shape, with deterministic successful Mean results and unchanged output metric identity.

CSV evidence records condition, size, shape, repetition, elapsed P50/P95 inputs, private-memory peak and after-run values, managed bytes, input/result/cache byte estimates, SDK/source/recipe identity, and hardware/process context; 20000x20000 is explicitly marked preflight-only or skipped with a reason.

A durable report, stable contract note, current handoff entry, and resolved issue record state that this is a measurement-only baseline, identify the existing owner/call path, and leave WPF rendering, monitor/DPI, low-memory, cancellation, camera, and hardware qualification unverified where not exercised.

evidence.observation: Debug measurement passed all six size/shape scenarios with 5 warm-ups and 30 measured runs each. CSV records input conversion, Runner calculation, context clone, bitmap publish, total P50/P95, private peak/after-run, managed GC bytes, result identity, estimated cache bytes, repository commit, SDK SHA, Recipe SHA, and host context; 20000² was preflight-only.

Release measurement passed the same six size/shape scenarios with 5 warm-ups and 30 measured runs each. The largest observed private peak was approximately 602 MiB for the 8192² two-layer case; the result metric and SHA identity remained stable across repetitions.

The report, stable contract, documentation map, and handoff identify the existing Runner/Mean/Result/Bitmap owner path, the measurement-only boundary, the 20000² preflight decision, exact D-drive evidence roots, and unverified WPF/UI/DPI/monitor/cancellation/low-memory/camera/hardware/long-duration limits. The next admitted boundary is 2D-036.

events.summary: Close 2D-034 as measurement-only evidence. Keep the existing Runner, Mean, ResultImage, and BitmapImageConverter owners; do not infer a product cap, cache eviction policy, diagnostic reduction, or parallelism rule until a separately scoped boundary uses this baseline.

All 2D-034 criteria have Debug/Release measurement and durable documentation evidence; unexercised UI, low-memory, cancellation, hardware, and long-duration boundaries remain explicitly outside this slice.
